g.text: Not used as inputs: customer_id (an identifier: almost every value is different).
Force a column in with --keep NAME.
'monthly_charges' holds numbers stored as text; they're converted.
plainml weights the rare classes automatically; see --balance for options.
Ranked by F1 (higher is better): balance of precision and recall, averaged over classes (1.0 is perfect)
On 300 held-out test rows: F1 0.6484 · Accuracy 0.7667 · ROC-AUC 0.7388
F1: balance of precision and recall, averaged over classes (1.0 is perfect)
Decision threshold tuned to 0.56 (instead of 0.5) to maximise F1.
• The model relies most on signup_date, support_calls and contract.
• Shuffling these on their own makes no measurable difference: plan, monthly_charges. They're either unhelpful or
duplicate information other columns already carry.
• Higher support_calls → 'yes' more likely (26% → 45% across its typical range).
• contract = 'monthly' makes 'yes' most likely (41%); 'annual' least likely (25%).
• region = 'north' makes 'yes' most likely (39%); 'south' least likely (32%).
